svg.text: E-003 12 V SERVICES, FIELD TERMINALS AND SENSOR INTERFACES
Independent conceptual study — unbuilt and unvalidated.
12 V services, field terminals and sensor interfaces
Author: Pratik Prabhakar Shinde | INDEPENDENT CONCEPT DESIGN
DXF R2013 / Layered vector drawing / A3 landscape
24 V CLASS TO 12 V SUPPLY / NON-ISOLATED CONVERTER / DEDICATED COPPER RETURNS
All terminal allocations are study references, NOT manufacturer pinouts.
Data/shield/termination requirements depend on selected devices.
Motor command links and antenna/feedthrough installation not detailed.
BRANCH WIRING: <=2 m one way; + and return each 0.75 mm2. Baseline 12 V load = 5.0 A.
Worst branch drop 0.180 V; plus C06 0.045 V = 0.225 V / 1.88%. Contact losses extra.
F5 limits usable panel load below D1 full 120 W rating. Recheck protection before adding payloads.
